newsitem.title: MALAWI: Malawi 3-month T-Bill rate up to 14.69 percent.
newsitem.headline: Malawi 3-month T-Bill rate up to 14.69 percent.

text.p: The average discount rate for Malawi's three-month Treasury bills rose by 0.17 point to 14.69 percent at the latest fortnightly tender from 14.52 percent, the Reserve Bank said on Thursday.
Applications for 21 million kwacha of bills on offer were fully subscribed at the average price of 96.6 percent.
The average rate for six-month bills dropped by 0.63 point to 16.02 percent from 16.65 percent two weeks ago.
Applications for the 102.9 million kwacha of bills on offer totalled 101.9 million kwacha. The average price was 93.01 percent.

For nine-month bills, the average rate rose by 1.06 points to 16.57 from 15.51 percent two weeks ago. Applications for the 30.2 million kwacha on offer totalled 28.8 million at the average price of 89.7 percent.
